# Devtacet — Comprehensive Agency Documentation & Knowledge Base

## Overview
Devtacet is a software engineering and digital solutions studio based in Lucknow, India, helping startups and businesses build high-performance Next.js web applications, React Native mobile apps, custom MIS & ERP platforms, real-time data analytics systems, and technical SEO/GEO.

- **Official Website**: https://devtacet.me
- **Headquarters**: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India
- **Industry**: Digital Solutions / Software Engineering / Mobile Apps / Web Development / Data Analytics / Technical SEO
- **Core Offerings**: Website Development, Mobile App Development, Custom Software & MIS, Data Analytics Systems, Technical SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Social Media Marketing
- **Client Engagement Model**: Direct access to senior staff engineers (L5–L7 tier experts) with zero middle-tier account manager telephone.

---

## Detailed Service Specifications

### 1. Website Development (https://devtacet.me/services/web-development)
- **Overview**: High-speed, conversion-focused websites, SaaS platforms, and enterprise web applications.
- **Technologies**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Vercel Edge Infrastructure.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Sub-second Core Web Vitals (LCP < 1.0s, INP < 100ms, CLS < 0.05)
  - Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Edge Functions
  - Type-safe full-stack architecture with strict TypeScript
  - Enterprise security, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, and clean semantic DOM markup

### 2. Mobile App Development (https://devtacet.me/services/mobile-app-development)
- **Overview**: Cross-platform iOS and Android applications engineered for fluid 60fps native feel.
- **Technologies**: React Native, Flutter, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Apple TestFlight, Google Play Console.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Single unified codebase across iOS and Android
  - Offline-first local data synchronization (SQLite)
  - Biometric authentication (FaceID, Fingerprint) and push notifications
  - 100% first-try App Store and Google Play Store review approval standard

### 3. Custom Software & MIS (https://devtacet.me/services/custom-software)
- **Overview**: Tailored internal business software, Management Information Systems (MIS), ERP-lite platforms, and automated workflow backends.
- **Technologies**: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, MongoDB / Mongoose, Next.js, Docker.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Replacement of fragile manual spreadsheets with centralized databases
  - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and data isolation
  - Automated business process pipelines saving 30+ hours weekly
  - Complete intellectual property and source code ownership

### 4. Data Analytics Systems (https://devtacet.me/services/analytics)
- **Overview**: Real-time KPI dashboards, automated ETL pipelines, and executive decision-support tools.
- **Technologies**: Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB Aggregation Pipeline, Redis Caching, Recharts/Chart.js.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Live data streaming with sub-50ms aggregation query response times
  - Automated ETL pipelines unifying disparate CRM, payment, and database sources
  - Scheduled automated executive export reports (PDF, CSV)
  - Drill-down charting and custom KPI builders

### 5. Technical SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) (https://devtacet.me/services/seo)
- **Overview**: Dual-layer search engine optimization targeting standard search engines (Google, Bing) and AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, SearchGPT, Google AI Overviews).
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Source-code-level technical SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD knowledge graphs, dynamic XML sitemaps
  - Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Direct answer structuring, entity-rich factual indexing, FAQ schemas, `/llms.txt` integration
  - Core Web Vitals optimization directly in React/Next.js code

### 6. Social Media Marketing (https://devtacet.me/services/social-media-marketing)
- **Overview**: Strategic social media marketing and brand positioning tailored for digital products, technology brands, and startups.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Multi-channel editorial calendars covering LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and developer communities
  - Product-led storytelling and founder brand positioning
  - Revenue-tied growth analytics and attribution tracking

## Case Studies Portfolio

1. **Atlas Analytics SaaS Platform** (https://devtacet.me/case-studies/atlas-redesign): Next-generation analytics platform with real-time stream processing, customizable charts, and sub-millisecond metrics queries.
2. **Relay Cloud API Engine** (https://devtacet.me/case-studies/relay-cloud-api): High-throughput edge routing engine and distributed microservices with global multi-region caching.
3. **Edge Deploy UI Platform** (https://devtacet.me/case-studies/edge-deploy-ui): Autonomous deployment orchestration and preview branch management for modern web applications.
4. **Pulseframe Mobile App** (https://devtacet.me/case-studies/pulseframe-mobile): Ultra-fast cross-platform design and collaboration workspace built with React Native.

---

## The Devtacet 7-Stage Engineering Lifecycle

1. **Requirements Discovery**: In-depth analysis of user journeys, business goals, and technical specifications.
2. **Technical Architecture**: Database schema design, API contract modeling, and tech stack selection.
3. **UI/UX Design Systems**: High-fidelity responsive layouts, accessible typography, and interactive prototypes.
4. **Full-Stack Engineering**: Modular, type-safe Next.js, React, Node.js, and mobile development.
5. **QA & Performance Testing**: Automated testing, cross-device QA, and Core Web Vitals audits.
6. **Deployment & Launch**: Zero-downtime deployment on Vercel/AWS cloud infrastructure.
7. **SEO, GEO & Maintenance**: Ongoing technical SEO, AI search indexation, and proactive software maintenance.
